FAQ

Heavyweight Hoodies questions

Why do heavyweight hoodies cost more?

More fabric per piece and heavier knitting. A 450 GSM hoodie uses roughly a third more cotton than a 330 GSM one.

Will a heavyweight hoodie shrink?

We pre-shrink fabric and can garment-wash before shipping.
